hints.title: Virtual Source Transformation
hints.text: Model building a well at house i as connecting house i to a virtual reservoir node 0 with edge cost wells[i - 1].

hints.title: Single Spanning Tree
hints.text: Combining pipe connections and virtual well edges converts the problem into finding the Minimum Spanning Tree across n + 1 nodes.

hints.title: Greedy Edge Union
hints.text: Sort all pipe and well edges by cost. Apply Kruskal algorithm until n edges are selected connecting all houses to the source.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: E: n wells + number of pipes
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separately choosing which houses build wells and which share pipes leads to exponential 2^N combination evaluations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: The virtual super-node abstraction enables Kruskal algorithm to solve well-and-pipe allocation in near-linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the classic super-source graph reduction technique.
complexity.notes: Virtual source node 0 unifies node weights with edge weights.
